article.headline: Minnesota faces Utah, looks for 4th straight victory
article.description: Utah Jazz (1-8, 15th in the Western Conference) vs. Minnesota Timberwolves (7-3, sixth in the Western Conference)
article.title: Minnesota faces Utah, looks for 4th straight victory
article.linkText: Minnesota faces Utah, looks for 4th straight victory
article.story: Utah Jazz (1-8, 15th in the Western Conference) vs. Minnesota Timberwolves (7-3, sixth in the Western Conference) Minneapolis; Sunday, 7 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: Minnesota will try to keep its three-game win streak intact when the Timberwolves take on Utah. Minnesota finished 49-33 overall, 31-21 in Western Conference games and 26-15 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Timberwolves averaged 8.7 steals, 5.8 blocks and 14.1 turnovers per game last season. Utah went 22-60 overall, 1-15 in Northwest Division action and 8-33 on the road a season ago. The Jazz averaged 18.0 points off of turnovers, 14.8 second-chance points and 38.8 bench points last season. INJURIES: Timberwolves: Joan Beringer: out (nose), Donte DiVincenzo: out (achilles), Terrence Shannon Jr.: out (hip), Anthony Edwards: out (knee). Jazz: Jusuf Nurkic: out (foot), Jaren Jackson Jr.: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
